sampling: Evenly spaced by original free-particle index within each role, alternating TRAIN/HOLDOUT.
continuation: Unchanged deep LocalSearch with natural slots; repeat visits only if the visit returns before the common budget. Four recipient preferences; common 200-point frozen paid reference, new personal history, no inherited Q state or family.
baseline: All known paid archive points up to FE5100 in S and U plus all source reference solutions are in A0 before any continuation. Already-good donor copies earn zero gain.
ordinaryControls: ELITE by target objective or PDDR
gate: Select best off-diagonal source on TRAIN only, test its four HOLDOUT parents per target. At least two SPECIAL target tasks must beat SELF/ELITE/RANDOM in mean heldout batch new HV to warrant an isolated closed-loop proposal; no tuning the threshold after results.
limits: Association of source role and solution quality remains; no novelty claim or full-cost efficacy from this screen. Uniform cohort is a diagnostic, not a weak final benchmark.
